sample_extractions.specific_condition: No finishes existing or called out in plans for storage room 02D8C
sample_extractions.impact: Uncertainty regarding ceiling height, ceiling type, and interior finishes, leading to additional work and costs for clarification and implementation
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Lack of specified finishes in design documents
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure all finishes are detailed in design documents before project initiation

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Detail 3/S5.02 does not show reinforcement for pan-fill stair tread infill
sample_extractions.impact: Uncertainty regarding structural integrity of stair tread infill, leading to potential safety concerns and additional work for reinforcement
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Lack of reinforcement specification for stair tread infill
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure all structural details are fully specified in design documents before issuing for construction

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Existing duct work prevents the roof access door from opening a full 90 degrees.
sample_extractions.impact: Requires modification of the door swing to a right-hand reverse (RHR) to allow proper access.
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Conduct a thorough review of existing MEP layouts during design phase to identify potential conflicts.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: No elevation or layout provided for the wood veneer paneling installation as per detail 9/A9.6.0.
sample_extractions.impact: Lack of clarity on the extent and orientation of veneer installation leads to additional work and costs for determining installation requirements.
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Missing elevation and layout details for veneer paneling
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure all necessary details for finishes, including elevations and layouts, are included in the design documents before issuance.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Framing/backing/blocking requirements for wood veneer panels at Stair 1 were unclear, leading to the conclusion that existing wall should be demoed and rebuilt.
sample_extractions.impact: Increased costs and additional work required to demo and rebuild the wall instead of following the original framing plan.
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Framing requirements for wood veneer panels not adequately detailed in the design documents.
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Provide detailed framing and blocking requirements in the design documents to avoid ambiguity.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Existing truss above the wall clashes with the new HSS4X4 column as per post-demo investigations.
sample_extractions.impact: The clash prevents the installation of the new HSS column as designed, requiring a shift of the column outside of the wall.
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Truss conflict with new column installation
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Conduct thorough post-demolition investigations to identify existing structural elements before finalizing design.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: No details showing the extent of install for the L-Bracket anchoring into the slab and its interaction with the wall panel under the stair were provided.
sample_extractions.impact: Lack of structural details led to uncertainty in installation, requiring additional work to clarify anchoring methods and interactions.
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure comprehensive structural details are included in submittals and RFIs to clarify installation requirements.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Current drawings do not show any FRP or Epoxy type paint being installed around the mop sink as required by building code.
sample_extractions.impact: Lack of specified wall protection around the mop sink could lead to water damage and code compliance issues.
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Absence of FRP or protective coating detail in construction documents.
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure all code-required details, such as wall protection around mop sinks, are included in the construction drawings during the design phase.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: The Mitsubishi DX Split System is designed to operate with stand-alone controls and is not integrated with the Building Management System (BMS).
sample_extractions.impact: The lack of BMS integration may lead to increased operational costs and inefficiencies in monitoring and controlling the HVAC system.
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Lack of BMS integration in the original design
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure that all HVAC system designs include BMS integration requirements during the design phase.

sample_extractions.specific_condition: Seismic bracing details for HVAC equipment not shown on mechanical drawings M0.2 Details 2 & 3
sample_extractions.impact: Units require seismic bracing per code, which was not accounted for in the original design
sample_extractions.root_cause_subcategory: Lack of seismic anchorage details for HVAC equipment
sample_extractions.prevention_action: Ensure all seismic requirements are included in mechanical drawings during design phase
